source.how: get_computed_styles for the declared values; get_node_info / get_children for the laid-out rects, whose world coordinates are what `gaps` is computed from.

note: The two figures with a box of their own. The activity pill (a padded one-line box with an asymmetric inset) and a parallel lane (the same pill, holding a 14px matrix, a 104px name, the activity, a 40px clock and a 16px chevron slot). The lane is the activity pill's box by design — the two read as one family — and both are places where a number could drift with nothing failing. The thought chain's lanes (node 16, text edge 24, clock 40, rail at 8) are asserted in chat-progress.browser.test.tsx against the sheet's node ids, because they are columns ACROSS rows rather than one box's inset.

lawsNotDeclared.uniform-inset: 12 inline and 8 block, deliberately — the pill is one line tall and a uniform 12 would make it a box. Tooltip's chip declares the same asymmetry for the same reason.
lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: Neither the verb nor the detail paints a fill, a border or a corner. The pill's radius-md is the only shape in the figure.

lawsNotDeclared.inset-is-declared: The sheet declares only padding-inline md and gets its block inset from a fixed 32px height with items-center — so its 8px top and bottom are laid out, not declared, and the law fails on the drawing itself. The render declares py-sm instead of the height (ADR 0019: a fixed height fighting padding is how Tabs drifted). The sheet's laid-out 8/12/8/12 is still asserted against the render by the inset test.
lawsNotDeclared.uniform-inset: 12 inline and 8 block, the activity pill's own asymmetry — the lane is that box.
lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: Nothing inside the lane paints a corner; its radius-md is the only shape in the figure.

deviations.what: The sheet's verb and detail are 60 and 548 wide — this specimen's own two strings; the render's are whatever the mounted strings measure.
deviations.why: The case exists for the 8px between them and the 8/12 inset. The detail is the flexing slot (flex-1, min-w-0, truncate), so its width moves with the copy and the column by design, and the law's arithmetic binds whatever it measures.

deviations.what: The render's lane is 33.55px tall where the sheet's is 32.
deviations.why: The sheet sets the label text at a 16px line height; the label-md role's own leading is 1.3 (16.9px), and ADR 0020 §3 forbids overriding it. The block inset stays the sheet's 8px on both sides — the box grows by the leading, not by the padding — which is the same figure the activity pill renders, and the browser test asserts the lane EQUALS the pill rather than either number.

deviations.what: The activity is 276px on the sheet; the render's is whatever the flexing slot gets.
deviations.why: The activity is flex-1, min-w-0 and truncates, so its width moves with the column by design. The case renders at the sheet's 506px lane so the track arithmetic binds the same total.
